description.en: Record promoted workerless Task.ready source, private evidence, historical smoke gates and the later integrated154-test gate without claiming complete CPU coverage.

source.active_application: Applied by root as bounded unified deltas; BorrowChecker and ModuleLoader were not changed by this batch.

contract.execution: A precomputed owned value is published as Completed without scheduling a callback, creating a Task worker or entering OS reaping.
contract.ownership: The observation retains the existing Task-to-Scope loan. The Scope owns an unclaimed result until observation or cleanup. This initial profile requires owned data and compiler-approved cleanup; borrowed values and hidden Task loans are rejected.
contract.failure: The by-value source input is consumed and cleaned once if preparation fails. The native prepare ABI itself does not read or move caller-owned input. A successful typed move is followed by allocation-free publication.
contract.admission: Prepared Ready counts as active; closing new admission after preparation preserves the accepted transaction. Publication makes it terminal, with remaining cleanup still tracked.
contract.diagnostic_identity: Ready uses the same non-recycled TaskId serial domain and preserves identity after observation consumption. Exhaustion is a constructor failure.
contract.JIT: Ready emits real result Drop callbacks and retains existing module-level lifecycle residency. No new per-Control JIT resource pin is claimed.

executed_private_prototype.boundary: All results below were obtained from an ignored private overlay and dedicated standalone programs. They do not establish a passing active compiler after root promotion.

gates.fault_stages: Fresh allocation budgets 0..7, closure of admission after preparation, thread/reap fault injection and already-closed Scope. Every successful/failed by-value input has exact cleanup and Task-runtime worker creation/native reap counters remain zero.

executed_private_prototype.log_availability: Evidence paths under build/ are local ignored artifacts, not published repository downloads.

active_integration.expanded_existing_gate: v03_task_air passed in the full suite; historical431 assertion count belongs to the private AIR probe.

targeted_smoke.boundary: Root built the promoted Ready implementation and ran only the native runtime, exhaustion, and JIT gates. This is not an active source CLI, fault CLI, AIR, or coherent/full-suite result.

integrated_full_suite.boundary: Registered local macOS ARM64 suite, including dedicated Ready/Box/Range materialization/proof gates; not every CPU catalog API or cross-target execution.

limits: The historical Ready smoke gate passed three tests; its source CLI, fault CLI, AIR and integrated154-test suite have since passed on b87fb39d, with remaining CPU catalog contracts still unresolved.
Private execution is local macOS ARM64 evidence; Linux and Windows require their own gates.
Task-runtime creation/reap counters establish zero Task worker creation/reaping. They are not a claim that compiler, JIT or test processes have no unrelated OS threads.
macOS LeakSanitizer is unavailable. Actually instrumented ASan programs and explicit native live-resource counters provide separate evidence.
The initial owned-data and approved-cleanup restriction is explicit; Ready does not run a worker.
This partial checkpoint does not establish all CPU library completion, Task.failed support, borrowed-child support or cancellation hierarchy.
